theorems.name: Submission.cbr_cc_current_algebra
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)), IsIntegerMultiplicity (0 : GeometricCurrentOn U n)) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B C : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (p q : ℤ), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, A ω = (p : ℝ) * B ω + (q : ℝ) * C ω) → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), A.massOn W ≤ (p.natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * B.massOn W + (q.natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * C.massOn W) ∧ ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (ι : Type) (F : Finset ι) (S : ι → GeometricCurrentOn U n) (m : ι → ℤ), IsOpen U → (∀ i ∈ F, IsIntegerMultiplicity (S i)) → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U n, IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Y ω = ∑ i ∈ F, (m i : ℝ) * S i ω) ∧ ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), Y.massOn W ≤ ∑ i ∈ F, ((m i).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * (S i).massOn W)
